limits: One local host; background OS activity and thermal state not controlled.
Configured compute participants are not a trace of all OS processes/threads.
Python uses processes; JavaScript uses fresh worker isolates; native languages use threads.
One warmup does not establish an identical JIT tier in every runtime.
Process wall time includes bootstrap, compilation when JIT, and different validation-output paths.
reproduction_stdin: Six lines containing 0, one seed before every warmup or measured sample.
